name: AI-Gude
description: Your own morning podcast from the news sources you follow, narrated by AI.

paths.name: Users
paths.description: One .toml file per user with their shows, feeds and schedules. A sample (me.toml) is put here on the first start.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, the Episodes' audio and the article cache.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: AI Gude web app, published on host as 6724

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
variables.description: Required for Episodes. A Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com/apikey), for writing the script and the voice.

variables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
variables.description: A Firecrawl key (firecrawl.dev) for reading the articles. Not needed with a Firecrawl of your own (AIGUDE_FIRECRAWL_URL).
